The area integral expands as A=C0+B epsilon+C epsilon^2; on its allowed curvature boundary A(m,epsilon_*)=F(m)=m+beta(m)J1(m)+beta(m)^2 J2(m). Middle F''<-0.1303, with F'(1.02)>0 and F'(1.17)<0, gives one joint maximizer.
